title: The Bookstore
setting: Saturday afternoon. Blossom Book House, Church Street. You're trying to find the Kannada-learning section. The staff member is helpful but rushed. You're about to ask in your best Kannada when a voice from behind a shelf cuts in, amused.

beats.native: ಅದು 'pus-ta-ka' ಅಲ್ಲ. 'pus-ta-kha.' Kha. Ee aspirated sound.
beats.translit: adu 'pus-ta-ka' alla. 'pus-ta-kha.' Kha. ee aspirated sound.
beats.en: It's not 'pus-ta-ka.' It's 'pus-ta-kha.' Kha. The aspirated sound.
beats.beat: from one shelf over. you can't see her yet.

beats.prompt: You turn. You see her. You say:

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ನಾನು ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೇನೆ — Bangalore ಗೆ ಬಂದು ಎರಡು ವಾರ.
choices.translit: dhanyavādagaḷu. nānu kaliyuttā iddēne — Bangalore-ge bandu eraḍu vāra.
choices.en: Thank you. I'm learning — two weeks in Bangalore.

beats.native: Two weeks ಗೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಾ ಸಾರ್. ಯಾವ book ಹುಡುಕ್ತಾ ಇದೀರಿ?
beats.translit: two weeks-ge cennāgi hēḷtīrā sār. yāva book huḍuktā idīri?
beats.en: For two weeks, you speak well, sir. What book are you looking for?
beats.beat: her own copy of something tucked under one arm

choices.native: Conversational Kannada. ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಒಂದು recommend ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
choices.translit: conversational Kannada. oḷḷe ondu recommend māḍtīrā?
choices.en: Conversational Kannada. Can you recommend a good one?
Honestly, anything that won't make me sound like a tourist.

beats.native: Ooh. ಒಬ್ಬ Vasudhendra ಓದೋ engineer. Now you have my attention.
beats.translit: ooh. obba Vasudhendra ōdō engineer. now you have my attention.
beats.en: Ooh. An engineer who reads Vasudhendra. Now you have my attention.
beats.beat: leans on the shelf, not in a hurry anymore

beats.native: ನಾನು Anika. ಒಂದು kaapi try ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ next door? Conversational Kannada — I can help.
beats.translit: nānu Anika. ondu kaapi try māḍtīrā next door? conversational Kannada — I can help.
beats.en: I'm Anika. Coffee next door? Conversational Kannada — I can help.
beats.beat: the offer is light. the eye contact isn't.

choices.native: ಆಯ್ತು Anika. ನಾನು [you] — ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ kaapi ತುಂಬಾ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
choices.translit: āytu Anika. nānu [you] — nimma joḍe kaapi tumbā oḷḷeyadu.
choices.en: Sure, Anika. I'm [you] — coffee with you sounds great.
